# Justice Development and Social Cohesion Initiative (JUDSCI) Bauchi
> Official AI Context and Knowledge Base for JUDSCI Bauchi (JDPC Bauchi)

JUDSCI Bauchi (Justice Development and Social Cohesion Initiative) is the official social development commission of the Catholic Diocese of Bauchi, also operating as the Justice, Development and Peace Commission (JDPC) Bauchi.

## Primary Mandate
To facilitate the building of a just, peaceful, and stable society across the Bauchi Diocese (encompassing Bauchi and Gombe States in North-East Nigeria) through the promotion of Gospel values of Justice, Peace, and Integral Human Development.

## Thematic Intervention Pillars
- **WASH (Water, Sanitation & Hygiene)**: Constructing motorized boreholes, hand pumps, rehabilitating community water infrastructure, and providing hygiene education across rural communities.
- **Peace Building & Social Cohesion**: Inter-community peace sports festivals, inter-faith dialogues, community conflict resolution mechanisms, and schools peace clubs.
- **Sustainable Agriculture & Livelihoods**: Farmer training in climate-smart agriculture, organic fertilizers, post-harvest loss reduction, and community food security.
- **Human Rights & Prison Apostolate**: Free legal aid, prison welfare visitations, bail interventions, inmate counseling, and human rights awareness.
- **Women & Youth Empowerment**: Vocational training (tailoring, computer literacy, soap making), Village Savings and Loan Associations (VSLA), and entrepreneurship starter packs.

## Geographic Coverage
- **Diocese**: Catholic Diocese of Bauchi
- **States Covered**: Bauchi State (20 LGAs) and Gombe State (11 LGAs), Nigeria.

## Official Publications & Resources
- **Annual Narrative Report 2023**: Comprehensive program audit and impact analysis. URL: https://www.judsci.org.ng/resources/ANNUAL_NARRATIVE_REPORT_2023.pdf
- **WASH Community Implementation & Sanitation Guide**: Field guidelines for rural community water management.
- **Peace Building & Inter-faith Dialogue Toolkit**: Practical mediation strategies for inter-religious harmony.
